title: Motor protection / overload
fullDescription:
Er1 on Thermomix TM5 and TM6 indicates the motor protection circuit tripped due to overload, jam, or excess weight in the bowl.

Reduce load and let the unit cool before retrying.

fixSteps.title: Reduce load
fixSteps.instruction: Empty bowl below MAX line, restart.

title: Bowl temperature sensor fault
fullDescription: Er2 indicates the bowl heater NTC sensor is open or shorted.

title: Heating element fault
fullDescription: Er3 indicates the heating element under the bowl base failed or is over-current.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Bowl assembly is sealed - service required.

title: Scale / weighing sensor fault
fullDescription: Er4 indicates the integrated scale is reading erratically. Caused by uneven surface or scale sensor drift.

title: Bowl lock fault
fullDescription: Er5 indicates the locking arms are not detected in the closed position. Required for safety.

title: Lid lock fault
fullDescription: Er6 indicates the lid is not detected as locked. Common when measuring cup is not placed correctly or lid magnet failed.

fixSteps.title: Lock lid
fixSteps.instruction: Turn lid clockwise to locked position.

title: Touchscreen fault
fullDescription: Er7 indicates touchscreen calibration error - typical after firmware update or panel hardware issue.

title: Wi-Fi module fault
fullDescription: Er8 indicates Wi-Fi module on TM6 is offline. Reset network settings.

title: Speed sensor fault
fullDescription: Er9 indicates the Hall sensor on the motor is reporting invalid speed.

title: Software / system fault
fullDescription: Er10 indicates a software fault on TM6. Reboot and update firmware.
